title: HSM AI — High-Speed Machining Intelligence

units.title: 16 HSM AI domains with Claude Opus prompts
units.details: Added 16 HSM-AI domains: hsm_trochoidal (trochoidal/adaptive clearing), hsm_chip_thinning (radial chip thinning), hsm_constant_engagement (engagement angle control), hsm_rest_machining (high-speed rest), hsm_pencil (pencil tracing), hsm_spiral (spiral pockets), hsm_contour (high-speed contouring), hsm_plunge_rough (plunge roughing), hsm_dynamic_feed (dynamic feed optimization), hsm_toolpath_smoothing (smoothing/filtering), hsm_corner_treatment (corner strategies), hsm_entry_strategy (engage strategies), hsm_retract_strategy (retract/linking), hsm_stock_awareness (stock-aware paths), hsm_air_cutting (air cut minimization), hsm_thermal_management (thermal load control)

summary: Complete high-speed machining AI intelligence with 16 domains covering trochoidal clearing, chip thinning, constant engagement, rest machining, pencil/spiral strategies, high-speed contouring, plunge roughing, dynamic feed, toolpath smoothing, corner treatment, entry/retract strategies, stock awareness, air cutting minimization, and thermal management. Deep expertise from 5 PDFs and HSMWorks/Fusion/Mastercam Dynamic strategies.
